source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 (ISLB A1) · lesson 3. Exercises reused from the lesson.

title.en: Allah is the Giver of Life

topic: Al-Muhyee: life comes from Allah, and our special gifts

learn.en: Allah is Al-Muhyee, The Giver of Life. Every living thing gets its life from Him.
learn.title: The Giver of Life

learn.en: A chicken comes from an egg, a tree from a seed. Everything has a beginning and an end.
learn.title: Everything has a beginning

learn.en: Allah is different: He has no beginning and no end. He is the Ever-Living.
learn.title: Allah is different

learn.en: Allah created the first man, Prophet Adam (peace be upon him), directly — a great honour for human beings.
learn.title: The first man

learn.en: Animals cannot talk like us and plants cannot think. Allah gave people two special gifts: speech and a mind to think.
learn.title: Our special gifts

learn.en: A robot can move, but it is not alive. Only Allah can put a living soul into something.
learn.title: A robot is not alive

learn.en: Put your hand on your heart. It beats without you telling it to — a gift of life. Say: Alhamdulillah!
learn.title: Feel your heart

words.en: The Giver of Life (a name of Allah)

quiz.en: True or false? Plants and animals can think and talk exactly the way human beings do.
True or false? Allah created the rules of time, beginnings and endings, so those rules do not apply to Him.
True or false? Everything in our world has a beginning and an end, but Allah has a beginning but no end.
Where did the very first man, Prophet Adam, come from?
If an engineer builds a robot, what will the robot NEVER have?
opts: The ability to move its arms
A living soul and a feeling heart

think.q: You wake up and your heart is beating and you are breathing without trying. What is the best word to thank Allah?
think.a: Alhamdulillah — all praise is for Allah!

parents.summary: Al-Muḥyī: Allah gives life; He has no beginning or end; He created Adam and gave people speech and a mind.
parents.tip: Plant a seed together and talk about who gives it life.
